shots.note: HOOK: frame 0 already intense: you (the mascot) gasping in black freezing water, breath fog, the lit stern standing up far behind
SPECTACLE: 'Two-twenty A.M. The sea's about minus two degrees': the stern standing huge, lights on, then the lights flicker out and it slides under; you small in the foreground
'Your body gasps by itself. Under a wave, that's deadly': close orbit on the gasp reflex; a wave washes over you (bubbles) at 272; the body timer appears
'Ten minutes, maybe less': low angle just over the water, wreckage in the foreground, your splashing weakens
'your arms stop working': close on your trembling hands gripping your life jacket; timer hits 10:00
'Would you jump early, or stay on the ship? Comment below': the lit ship mid-sinking, bow under, stern rising; you small in the foreground; the one choice pill
'Lifeboats float nearby, many half empty': a half-empty lifeboat rows away, you reach after it
'Only one comes back': Lifeboat 14 out of the mist, Lowe's lantern held high at the bow
'Lifeboat fourteen': high angle down on you among the wreckage, the lantern light falls on you; relief
'Yet chief baker Charles Joughin said he lasted about two hours': the portly baker floats calmly beside you, chatting
'His secret? Legend says whisky': close on the baker raising a little flask (legend, not proven)
'Scientists doubt it helped': close on you, sceptical, shivering
'Episode two: Pompeii. Follow, so you don't miss it': you wave to camera, EP 2 tag; cut back to the hook on the hook clock (last frame = frame 0)
